selection_reason: The paper targets long-context LLM inference efficiency. It calibrates each layer's contribution to answer-token prediction by measuring the NLL change when that layer uses full attention rather than sliding-window attention during prefill, then keeps only the top-k layers full-attention while retaining full-attention decode. This directly addresses prefill compute and accuracy tradeoffs in hybrid attention deployment, so it is in scope for inference/serving.
title: NLL-Guided Full-Attention Layer Selection for Training-Free Sliding-Window Adaptation
